title: Donald Duck: Goin' Quackers
text:
Donald Duck: Goin' Quackers is a platform game based on the Disney character Donald Duck, Developed by Ubisoft Casablanca for the Nintendo 64, Microsoft Windows, and the Sega Dreamcast. The PS1 version was developed by Ubisoft Shanghai.
